Description.Name: Course For Folly
Description.Details:
<color=#BFBFBF>An encrypted message arrives. No greeting, no frills. Just text, cold and precise, clearly Bekker's work.</color>

<color=#DFDFDF>"Proceed immediately to the McEvedy's Folly system. A contact awaits. Prepare for travel. We will speak when you arrive."</color>

<color=#BFBFBF>Darius narrows his eyes as the terminal blips off.</color> "McEvedy's Folly… I've read about it. Fringe system. Independent world. No faction in control."

<color=#BFBFBF>Farah clicks through system stats on her datapad.</color> "Minimal infrastructure. Small population, no [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHPG],HPGs]], limited services. Makes it ideal for off-the-grid meetings."

<color=#BFBFBF>Sumire crosses her arms, expression unreadable.</color> "That's exactly why Bekker wants us there. Hidden. Unmonitored."

Description.Name: Plot the jump. We move now.
Description.Details: [A new flashpoint has been created in the McEvedy's Folly system to continue the campaign]
